thread:
lucas-finops: quick heads upbilling alert: Customer AcmeCorp was invoiced for $8.2k of GPU spend but our customer mapping shows only $2.1k. discrepancy in allocation.
nina-sales: omg customers noticed? they pinged AM yesterday morning asking why their bill jumped.
marta-ops: likely tag drift again. did we recently change the autoscaler label key?
lucas-finops: billing CSV extract (redacted) - look at missing cust_tag on two lines:
```
invoice_id,resource,region,amount,cust_tag
inv-2026-03-01,gpu-pool-7,us-west1,4100.00,AcmeCorp
inv-2026-03-01,gpu-pool-8,us-west1,4100.00,unknown
inv-2026-03-01,gpu-n3,us-east1,2100.00,AcmeCorp
```
marta-ops: that unknown line is half the billed amount. I'll grep instance labels and creation events.
billing-bot: Automated note: created ticket FIN-799 for invoice mismatch. https://billing.internal/tickets/FIN-799
sara-cfo: timeline: customers must get corrected invoice or credit within 5 business days. Ops + Fin need joint plan.
lucas-finops: propose: 1) run backfill for untagged resources from audit logs (48h) 2) if >90% matches AcmeCorp, issue corrected invoice; 3) else issue provisional credit and escalate.
nina-sales: ping AM so they can prep comms. we need language for customer email.
marta-ops: started backfill job (job-id bg-backfill-1771). pulling labels now.

marta-ops: backfill results: matched 68% of unknown line to AcmeCorp based on instance owner/email. remaining $1312 ambiguous.
lucas-finops: because <90% we should issue provisional credit of $1312 and flag as "under investigation" on invoice. also schedule follow-up to reconcile final numbers next invoice cycle.
sara-cfo: agreed. Customer-facing wording: "We detected a billing allocation issue affecting a subset of GPU usage. We have applied a provisional credit of $1,312 while we complete an internal reconciliation. Final adjustments will appear on your next invoice." Approve?
nina-sales: approved. i'll coordinate AM note. :white_check_mark:
marta-ops: adding alert: when untagged GPU run-rate > $1k/week, create auto incident and cc finops + AM. also adding a validation step in the billing pipeline to reject invoices with >20% untagged GPU spend.
lucas-finops: please also include a weekly report for top 10 untagged resources and the derived owner mapping. that'll help prevent repeat.
billing-bot: FIN-799 updated: provisional credit $1,312 applied to invoice inv-2026-03-01. Follow-up task assigned to marta-ops.
marta-ops: created PR to restore label key mapping (PR#4567). will roll patch tomorrow 03:00 UTC.
lucas-finops: I'll log the provisional credit in the ledger and note the allocation policy change.
sara-cfo: thanks team. ensure customer comms go through legal review before send. reopen if anything else crops up. :eyes:
